desc: Pressure-treated deck ledger bolted to a Florida stucco wall with continuous metal Z-flashing, visible water-resistive layer, joist hangers, and clean in-progress framing.
reuse_notes: Use for deck-ledger flashing, deck framing, attachment details, water-management sequencing, joist-hanger, and outdoor-construction articles. It depicts a generic in-progress assembly, never a JK Prestige project or proof that a particular attachment method suits every house.
